release_git_sha_note: The v1.0.0 tag points at this commit's own immediate child (a single small follow-up commit that records this exact SHA here, since a commit cannot self-referentially embed its own hash) -- both commits together are the release; the child adds nothing except this field.
runtime_source_note: v1.0.0's code/doc changes are non-runtime (LICENSE, docs, version metadata fields not read at runtime -- API_VERSION was already hardcoded to 1.0.0 independent of pyproject.toml). No container rebuild was required or performed for this release; the runtime images in production are unchanged from M10 and are documented here as a legitimate, explicitly-noted distinction from release_git_sha, per this project's own release-tagging governance rule.
